items.title: Higher energy density
items.text: SiBoost combines graphite's conductivity with silicon's capacity to store lithium, so cells can hold more energy at the same size.

items.title: Drop-in compatibility
items.text: Our process adapts to graphite grades already used across the industry, including material that's currently under-used because of its characteristics.

items.title: Smaller or lighter cells
items.text: The same performance in less volume and weight — or more performance in the footprint manufacturers already have.

hero.headline: More energy in your battery.
hero.text: Enwires builds silicon-graphite composites that raise the energy density of lithium-ion batteries — without changing how they're manufactured.

who.heading: Who we are
who.p1: Enwires is a team of around ten people, working alongside experts from the battery industry. We focus on one problem: how far a graphite-based anode can be pushed before it needs to be replaced.
who.p2: Lithium-ion batteries are one of the most widely used technologies of modern life, and one of the most constrained. We build materials that extend what's already in production, rather than asking manufacturers to start over.

stat.label: energy density compared with the graphite currently used in lithium-ion batteries

what.heading: What is SiBoost?
what.p1: SiBoost is a graphite-silicon composite (Gr-Si) that pairs graphite's electronic conductivity with silicon's ability to interact with and store lithium ions.
what.p2: That combination is what pushes the energy density beyond what graphite alone can offer — anywhere from 1.1 to 4 times the performance, depending on the formulation and the target application.

cta.heading: Bring your own graphite
cta.text: Our production line adapts to most graphite materials already used in the industry — tell us what you're working with and we'll tell you what SiBoost can do with it.
